ideas.title: +1 Toughness Per Fall 🪂
ideas.hook: You are the test dummy. Robot launchers fling you across a realistic lab, and every landing adds +1 toughness so you can survive the next, bigger launcher.
core_loop: Step onto a robot launcher
Get flung into walls, glass and crash pads
Gain +1 toughness per impact (more for harder hits)
Use toughness to unlock stronger launchers and new test chambers
Rebirth for a permanent toughness multiplier
ideas.twist: Each chamber has a 'scientist' leaderboard: the player who took the hardest single hit that hour gets to pick which launcher everyone uses next.
retention: Rebirth tiers with new chamber themes
Daily reward crate of launch skins
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is at 2.30 (up 0.28 this week) with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 at 44,757 CCU and [🎩] Ragdoll Research at 24,297 CCU at only 11 days. +1 stat per action holds at 2.20 across 38 new games, and Hit / swing / launch leads all mechanics at 2.77. Realistic art (2.03) and interiors (2.09) are the two fastest-rising styles.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are free sandboxes with no progression; here every crash is a stat gain that unlocks the next launcher.

ideas.title: Draw a Dam 🌊
ideas.hook: A flood is coming in 30 seconds. Draw walls, channels and ramps with your marker to steer the water away from your house before it hits.
core_loop: See where the flood will come from
Draw lines that turn into solid walls
Watch the water flow and break weak spots
Keep your house dry to earn coins
Buy stronger ink (stone, steel, ice) for bigger floods
ideas.twist: Ink is shared: every round the whole server draws on one map, so a neighbour's channel can send water straight into your yard.
retention: New disaster maps each week (lava, mudslide)
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.83 with 21 new games, spread out, and Paint / create + Disaster / weather is the second biggest gap in the data (score 4.17). Disaster / weather is at 1.59, with [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! at 13,582 CCU and [UPD 3] Create A Disaster💥 at 7,484 CCU at 22 days.
ideas.differentiator: Create A Disaster lets you cause the disaster; here you draw the defence, and the flood physics judges your drawing.

ideas.title: Guess Planets for Rockets 🪐
ideas.hook: Two players, one zoomed-in planet. Guess it from the clues before your rival does and the winner's rocket gets the next part.
core_loop: Get a close-up clue (craters, rings, colour)
Lock in a guess before the timer
Correct answers add parts to your rocket
First rocket to launch wins the round
Spend stars on rocket skins
ideas.twist: Wrong guesses send your rocket part to your opponent, so guessing wild is risky.
retention: New solar systems of made-up planets each update
ideas.why_now: Space is at 1.88 (up 0.30 this week) with Sweep The Moon 🌕 at 23,969 CCU at 16 days. Quiz / guess is rising at 1.21 with Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] at 6,464 CCU and Find The Country 🌍 at 1,740 CCU. The "___ for ___" title formula sits at 1.53.
ideas.differentiator: Find The Country is a solo map quiz; this is a head-to-head race where answers build a rocket you can see.

ideas.title: Moon Gift Shop [Anomaly] 🌕
ideas.hook: Run the only gift shop on a moon base. Sell souvenirs to tourists, but some tourists are not human. Spot them before closing time.
core_loop: Stock shelves with moon souvenirs
Serve tourists at the till
Watch for anomalies (wrong shadows, no helmet, too many fingers)
Hit the alarm on the anomaly to bank the day's cash
Upgrade the shop between shifts
ideas.twist: Hitting the alarm on a real tourist costs you the day's earnings, so each call is a gamble.
ideas.why_now: Interiors are the top rising map style at 2.09 with [💎] Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 at 33,368 CCU. Sell / run a shop is at 1.48 with 🧸 My Small Business at 18,715 CCU at 22 days, and Space is at 1.88 (up 0.30) led by Sweep The Moon 🌕.
ideas.differentiator: Sell Fries is set on Earth with a single customer line; here the setting and the anomaly tells are built around helmets, airlocks and low gravity.

ideas.title: Grow Roots for Freedom 🌱
ideas.hook: You smuggled one seed into your cell. Grow it in secret, sell crops to other inmates, and let its roots crack the wall for your escape.
core_loop: Plant and water under your bunk
Hide plants when guards patrol
Trade harvests to inmates for tools
Grow roots that break walls and floors
Escape through the yard before lockdown
ideas.twist: Other players can snitch on your plant for a reward, so you need to trade with them to keep them quiet.
monetization: VIP cell with a window planter
retention: Seed index with rare escape plants
New prisons to break out of
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm + Prison / police is a top gap (score 3.46). Grow / farm is at 1.44 (up 0.32 this week) with [UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 at 17,898 CCU at 18 days, and Prison / police is at 1.47 (up 0.28) with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] at 14,049 CCU. Escape is rising at 1.72 (up 0.81).
ideas.differentiator: Punch Out Of Prison is a straight smash-the-wall loop; here escape comes from a farm you must grow and hide over several sessions.

ideas.title: Deck of Mechs 🤖
ideas.hook: Every card is a mech part. Draw a head, arms and legs, snap them into one robot, and watch it fight another player's build.
core_loop: Open part packs
Pick 3 cards to build your mech
Auto-battle another player's mech
Win parts and scrap
Scrap duplicates to upgrade rare cards
ideas.twist: Parts from the same set give a combo bonus, so a weak full set can beat a strong mixed build.
retention: Offline scrap earnings from your hangar
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards + Robots / mechs is an open gap (score 2.71). Robots / mechs is at 1.78 with Sweep The Moon 🌕 at 23,969 CCU and Build A Mech! at 2,985 CCU. Dice / cards is at 1.18 across 11 new games, and Fight / battle + RNG roll is a working pair with 9 new games at 35,768 CCU combined.
ideas.differentiator: Card games here are anime or cute collectibles; cards become physical robot parts you see assembled and fighting.

ideas.title: Torch Planks for Cash 🔥
ideas.hook: Burn designs into wood with a blowtorch, then sell the finished signs at your stall. Cleaner burns sell for more.
core_loop: Pick an order (name sign, animal, logo)
Trace the stencil with your torch
Get scored on accuracy
Sell to customers at your stall
Buy better torches and rarer wood
ideas.twist: Hold the torch too long and the plank catches fire: put it out fast to save the piece or start a new one.
retention: Wood types to unlock (oak to obsidian)
Free-draw gallery players can vote on
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.83 and Paint / create + Ice / fire / elements is a top gap (score 4.10). Ice / fire / elements is at 1.28 with [UPD] Firefighting Sim 🚒 among its examples, and newcomer paint games like Clean a Painting (2,513 CCU) win on close-up satisfying work. Realistic art is the fastest-rising style at 2.03.
ideas.differentiator: Clean a Painting removes grime; here you create something new with fire, and the fire can ruin it.

ideas.title: Escape the Shaking Mall 🛒
ideas.hook: An earthquake hits a giant shopping mall. Shelves fall, escalators collapse, and the exits move every round. Get out with as many items as you can carry.
core_loop: Shop for loot when the round starts
Feel the first tremor and run
Dodge falling shelves and cracking floors
Reach an open exit before the final quake
Spend what you carried out on perks
ideas.twist: Items you carry slow you down, so you choose between a bigger haul and a safer run.
ideas.why_now: Interiors are at 2.09 and realistic art at 2.03, both led by DONT SPLASH at 87,736 CCU at 22 days. Escape is at 1.72 (up 0.81 this week) with [⭐UPD] Survive Your Ideas at 45,408 CCU, and Disaster / weather is at 1.59.
ideas.differentiator: Classic disaster games drop you on an open island; this is a dense indoor map where the building itself is the hazard and greed slows you down.

ideas.title: +1 Stilt Per Step 🦒
ideas.hook: Every step adds +1 to your stilts. Get tall enough to step over walls, but taller stilts wobble more.
core_loop: Walk to gain stilt height
Step over walls that need a minimum height
Balance through wind and narrow bridges
Fall and keep half your height
Rebirth for faster growth
ideas.twist: Some gates are low tunnels, so you have to drop height on purpose to squeeze through.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is at 2.20 with 34 new games, led by [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution at 35,108 CCU and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ at 23,940 CCU at 20 days. Giant / huge is at 1.76 (up 0.31 this week) with Bug Evolution [🦟] at 27,552 CCU, and linear courses are at 1.90.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games just grow a number; here height is both your power and your risk, and some gates need you short.

ideas.title: Dice vs the Horde 🧟
ideas.hook: Zombies walk down the lane. Roll your dice each wave: the faces you get decide which walls, traps and turrets you can place.
core_loop: Roll 5 dice at the start of a wave
Spend faces on walls, traps or turrets
Hold the lane until the wave ends
Earn new dice faces from bosses
Build a stronger dice set for the next night
ideas.twist: You can re-roll, but every re-roll lets the horde take one step closer.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards + Zombies is an open gap (score 2.84). Zombies is at 1.38 across 10 new games and Dice / cards is at 1.18, with [🎉UPD 3] Roll A Stickman! at 7,018 CCU and [ 👻 🎃] Anime Card Clash at 5,362 CCU. Voxel / blocky art is the second fastest-rising style at 1.78.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie defense games give fixed towers; here every wave's defense is random, and choosing when to re-roll is the skill.
